_comment: HAND ANNOTATIONS FOR THE MISSION CONTROL BOARD. Edit this file through the GitHub web UI. The builder reads it on every run and merges it into the render, so anything written here survives every rebuild. index.html itself is generated: a note typed straight into it is gone at the next refresh.
_how: One entry per job, keyed by the job NUMBER as a string. Every field is optional. 'note' adds a sentence to the What Closes It list on that job's expand card. 'badge' adds one extra badge chip. 'name' pins the display address, overriding whatever JobTread carries. Delete a field to drop it; delete the whole entry to drop them all. Keys matching no active job are ignored, so an entry can be left in place while a job is closed.
_rules: No em dash and no en dash: the build refuses to publish if either reaches the page, and the refusal names this file. Same for the banned court terms. Valid JSON only. A syntax error here stops the refresh rather than silently dropping every annotation, and posts a JobTread comment saying so.
_dont_restate_the_engine: The board now lists every unsigned draft or pending customer order on a job by itself: the document number, the scope, whether it is sitting with the client or was never sent, the amount, and how many days it has been out. A note that repeats that is a second copy of a live figure that nobody will remember to update. Write notes about what the engine cannot know.
